---
title: "`r params$report_title`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    theme: flatly
params:
  report_title: "Digital Soil Mapping Report"
  project: ""
  lang: "en"
  repo_root: ""
  proj_root: ""
  target_id: ""
  property: ""
  d1: 0
  d2: 30
  country_code: ""
  project_code: ""
  cov_data_path: ""
  model_path: ""
  metrics_path: ""
  mean_map_path: ""
  sd_map_path: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

if (!exists("msg", mode = "function")) {
  i18n_path <- file.path(params$repo_root, "02_scripts", "i18n", "load_i18n.R")
  if (file.exists(i18n_path)) source(i18n_path, local = FALSE)
}

if (!exists("parse_cog_attributes", mode = "function")) {
  targets_path <- file.path(params$repo_root, "R", "targets.R")
  if (file.exists(targets_path)) source(targets_path, local = FALSE)
}

tr <- function(key, ...) {
  msg(key, params$lang, ..., repo_root = params$repo_root)
}

# Load data objects
dat <- if (file.exists(params$cov_data_path)) read.csv(params$cov_data_path) else NULL
model_obj <- if (file.exists(params$model_path)) readRDS(params$model_path) else NULL
metrics_obj <- if (file.exists(params$metrics_path)) jsonlite::fromJSON(params$metrics_path) else NULL

mean_r <- if (file.exists(params$mean_map_path)) terra::rast(params$mean_map_path) else NULL
sd_r   <- if (file.exists(params$sd_map_path)) terra::rast(params$sd_map_path) else NULL

detect_algorithm_str <- function(met_obj, mod_obj) {
  if (!is.null(met_obj) && !is.null(met_obj$algorithm) && nzchar(as.character(met_obj$algorithm))) {
    return(as.character(met_obj$algorithm))
  }
  if (!is.null(mod_obj)) {
    is_qr <- isTRUE(mod_obj$dots$quantreg) ||
             isTRUE(mod_obj$finalModel$quantreg) ||
             isTRUE(mod_obj$quantreg) ||
             (is.call(mod_obj$call) && isTRUE(as.logical(as.list(mod_obj$call)$quantreg)))
    if (is_qr) {
      return("Quantile Regression Forest (ranger)")
    } else {
      return(sprintf("ranger (quantile regression: %s)", tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")))
    }
  }
  tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")
}
```

## `r tr("rmd_sec_summary")`

- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_project")`:** `r params$project`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_target_prop")`:** `r params$property`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_depth_range")`:** `r sprintf("%.1f - %.1f cm", as.numeric(params$d1), as.numeric(params$d2))`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_country")`:** `r params$country_code`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_proj_code")`:** `r params$project_code`

## `r tr("rmd_sec_obs")`

<p><strong>`r if (!is.null(dat)) sprintf(tr("rmd_obs_count"), nrow(dat)) else ""`</strong></p>

### `r tr("rmd_obs_map_title")` & `r tr("rmd_obs_hist_title")`

```{r obs_plots}
if (!is.null(dat) && "x" %in% names(dat) && "y" %in% names(dat)) {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3.5, 1))
  plot(
    dat$x, dat$y,
    pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = "#2c3e50",
    xlab = tr("rmd_lbl_coord_x"), ylab = tr("rmd_lbl_coord_y"),
    main = tr("rmd_obs_map_title"),
    cex.main = 0.85
  )
  grid()
  
  target_col <- if (params$property %in% names(dat)) params$property else names(dat)[3]
  vals <- dat[[target_col]]
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) > 0) {
    hist(
      vals,
      col = "#3498db", border = "white",
      xlab = params$property,
      ylab = tr("rmd_lbl_frequency"),
      main = tr("rmd_obs_hist_title"),
      cex.main = 0.85
    )
  }
}
```

## `r tr("rmd_sec_model")`

### `r tr("rmd_sec_model_spec")`

- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_algorithm")`:** `r detect_algorithm_str(metrics_obj, model_obj)`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_train_rows")`:** `r if (!is.null(metrics_obj$training_rows)) sprintf("n = %d", as.integer(metrics_obj$training_rows)) else tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_boruta_decisions")`:** `r if (!is.null(metrics_obj$boruta_confirmed)) sprintf(tr("model_boruta_decisions"), as.integer(metrics_obj$boruta_confirmed), as.integer(metrics_obj$boruta_tentative), as.integer(metrics_obj$boruta_rejected)) else tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_hyperparams")`:** `r if (!is.null(metrics_obj$hyperparameters) && !is.null(metrics_obj$hyperparameters$mtry)) sprintf("mtry = %d, splitrule = '%s', min.node.size = %d", as.integer(metrics_obj$hyperparameters$mtry), as.character(metrics_obj$hyperparameters$splitrule), as.integer(metrics_obj$hyperparameters$min_node_size)) else tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_cores_time")`:** `r if (!is.null(metrics_obj$cores_used) && !is.null(metrics_obj$elapsed_seconds)) sprintf(tr("model_cores_time"), as.integer(metrics_obj$cores_used), as.numeric(metrics_obj$elapsed_seconds)) else tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated")`

### `r tr("rmd_cv_title")`

```{r cv_metrics_table}
if (!is.null(metrics_obj)) {
  fmt_val <- function(val) {
    if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) tr("rmd_val_not_evaluated") else sprintf("%.4f", as.numeric(val))
  }
  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    ME = fmt_val(metrics_obj$ME %||% metrics_obj$me),
    MAE = fmt_val(metrics_obj$MAE %||% metrics_obj$mae),
    RMSE = fmt_val(metrics_obj$RMSE %||% metrics_obj$rmse),
    R2 = fmt_val(metrics_obj$r2 %||% metrics_obj$R2),
    MEC = fmt_val(metrics_obj$MEC %||% metrics_obj$mec),
    CCC = fmt_val(metrics_obj$rhoC %||% metrics_obj$CCC),
    Cb = fmt_val(metrics_obj$Cb %||% metrics_obj$cb)
  )
  knitr::kable(metrics_df, format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-striped table-bordered'")
}
```

### `r tr("rmd_scatter_title")`

```{r cv_scatter}
if (!is.null(model_obj) && !is.null(model_obj$pred)) {
  best_tune <- model_obj$bestTune
  preds_df <- model_obj$pred
  if (!is.null(best_tune)) {
    for (nm in names(best_tune)) {
      if (nm %in% names(preds_df)) {
        preds_df <- preds_df[preds_df[[nm]] == best_tune[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(preds_df) > 0 && "obs" %in% names(preds_df) && "pred" %in% names(preds_df)) {
    lims <- range(c(preds_df$obs, preds_df$pred), na.rm = TRUE)
    plot(
      preds_df$obs, preds_df$pred,
      pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = rgb(0.17, 0.24, 0.31, 0.5),
      xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
      xlab = tr("rmd_lbl_observed"), ylab = tr("rmd_lbl_predicted"),
      main = tr("rmd_scatter_title"),
      cex.main = 0.85
    )
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
    grid()
  }
}
```

## `r tr("rmd_sec_varimp")`

<p><em>`r tr("rmd_varimp_source")`</em></p>

```{r varimp_plot}
ranger_mod <- if (!is.null(model_obj$finalModel)) model_obj$finalModel else model_obj
if (!is.null(ranger_mod) && !is.null(ranger_mod$variable.importance)) {
  imp <- ranger_mod$variable.importance
  imp_sorted <- sort(imp, decreasing = FALSE)
  top_n <- min(15, length(imp_sorted))
  imp_top <- tail(imp_sorted, top_n)
  
  par(mar = c(4, 10, 3, 2))
  barplot(
    imp_top,
    horiz = TRUE, las = 1,
    col = "#1abc9c", border = "white",
    xlab = tr("rmd_lbl_importance"),
    cex.main = 0.85
  )
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NA)
}
```

## `r tr("rmd_sec_cog")`

```{r cog_info}
mean_attrs <- parse_cog_attributes(params$mean_map_path)
sd_attrs   <- parse_cog_attributes(params$sd_map_path)

mean_crs <- "Unknown"
mean_res <- "Unknown"

if (!is.null(mean_r)) {
  mean_crs <- terra::crs(mean_r, describe = TRUE)$name
  if (is.na(mean_crs) || is.null(mean_crs)) mean_crs <- terra::crs(mean_r)
  res_vals <- terra::res(mean_r)
  mean_res <- sprintf("%.6f, %.6f", res_vals[1], res_vals[2])
}

is_both_cog <- isTRUE(mean_attrs$is_cog) && isTRUE(sd_attrs$is_cog)
format_display <- if (is_both_cog) tr("rmd_format_cog") else tr("rmd_format_geotiff")
```

- **`r tr("rmd_cog_format")`:** `r format_display`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_mean_map")` (`r basename(params$mean_map_path)`):** `r if (!is.null(mean_attrs)) sprintf("LAYOUT=%s, COMPRESSION=%s, BLOCK=%s, PREDICTOR=%s, NoData=%s", mean_attrs$layout, mean_attrs$compression, mean_attrs$block, mean_attrs$predictor, mean_attrs$nodata) else "Unknown"`
- **`r tr("rmd_lbl_sd_map")` (`r basename(params$sd_map_path)`):** `r if (!is.null(sd_attrs)) sprintf("LAYOUT=%s, COMPRESSION=%s, BLOCK=%s, PREDICTOR=%s, NoData=%s", sd_attrs$layout, sd_attrs$compression, sd_attrs$block, sd_attrs$predictor, sd_attrs$nodata) else "Unknown"`
- **`r tr("rmd_cog_res")`:** `r mean_res`
- **`r tr("rmd_cog_crs")`:** `r mean_crs`
